job: Between patients, wipe down the high-touch ledges in the clinic: the corridor window sill and the ledge at the reception desk in the waiting room.
understood_as: Wipe the corridor window sill and the reception-desk ledge in the waiting room with a cloth, as a between-patient clean of high-touch surfaces.
steps: Wipe the corridor window sill in pressing strokes.
Move to the waiting room and wipe the reception-desk ledge the same way.

demos.why: Shows the stroke pattern and how hard to press the cloth along a narrow ledge or sill.
Shows how firmly to grip the cloth so it does not slip out while pressing and dragging it.

questions: How will the robot know a patient has left? The plan covers one round of wiping, but something has to start it each time, such as a button at reception or a fixed schedule.
unmet: Running the wipe automatically between patients is not part of these tasks. They describe one cleaning round, and something still has to start each round.
